subject: Engineering decisions
title: Registry dependencies in CI, and the 90 s Nx stall (2026-11-02)
question: What was measured for Registry dependencies in CI, and the 90 s Nx stall (2026-11-02)?
workload: Registry dependencies in CI, and the 90 s Nx stall (2026-11-02)
method: Transcribed from the cited historical record. Units and precision follow the source.
finding: That run also resolved `service-kit 0.1.1` and `rca-ladder 0.1.1` from `libs-proxy` inside Docker builds (BuildKit RUN steps reach the tailnet name), and the migrated services built and deployed in 3 to 4 min each (remote-chat-agent 6 m 17 s, leetcode-backend 4 m 08 s, leetcode-auth-cookie-capture 3 m 54 s, reporting-service 3 m 44 s, vnc-auth-session 3 m 57 s).

rows: - Run 41387049219 (8e1e0a03e, the library migration): `typecheck-lint-unit-tests` hit its 20 min step limit with every Nx lookup a cache hit. The `WF_NX_TRACE` request log showed the cache requests arriving in bursts exactly 90 s apart (04:20:31, 04:22:01, 04:23:31, 04:25:01), the idle timeout of a pooled client connection; the shim now answers one request per connection (`Connection: close`) and logs each answer time. Run 41392534745 (8446c9d08): the same stage took 2 m 22 s.

- That run also resolved `service-kit 0.1.1` and `rca-ladder 0.1.1` from `libs-proxy` inside Docker builds (BuildKit RUN steps reach the tailnet name), and the migrated services built and deployed in 3 to 4 min each (remote-chat-agent 6 m 17 s, leetcode-backend 4 m 08 s, leetcode-auth-cookie-capture 3 m 54 s, reporting-service 3 m 44 s, vnc-auth-session 3 m 57 s).

- `deploy (vm-ops-api)` failed in both runs, for two different reasons. 41392534745: the vm-ops-api and watchdog builds ran together on one shared cargo registry cache mount and both unpacked service-kit (`failed to open .cargo-ok: File exists`); every Dockerfile now has a cache of its own (`id=cargo-registry-<image>`). 41396448439: the cold build (every dependency compiled once, 14 min) printed nothing for 200 s, so the client gave up while the VM job finished with exit 0 and pushed the image; the next push finds it cached.

- The wf-harness flow test `a_browser_script_drives_the_daemon_waits_by_observer_and_reports` read a 982 ms wait slice against a 990 to 1000 ms window on a loaded sandbox; the window is 900 to 1000 ms now.
